request.query: Finsupp support contained in a set and all coefficient values in closed intervals

items.name: Finset.mem_finsupp_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι →₀ α} {t : ι → Finset α},
  f ∈ s.finsupp t ↔ f.support ⊆ s ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∈ t i

items.name: Finset.mem_dfinsupp_iff
Finsupp.support_subset_iff
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Zero M] {s : Set α} {f : α →₀ M}, ↑f.support ⊆ s ↔ ∀ a ∉ s, f a = 0

items.name: DFinsupp.support_subset_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Zero (β i)]
